posts.title: The Love Unlimited Orchestra: Love’s Theme
posts.description: Remarks: A proto-disco song that Barry White wrote in 1965! It did not come out till 1973, by way of his Love Unlimited Orchestra. It was a top-10 hit throughout the Anglosphere except for New Zealand, where it “only” reached #12. If you could bottle the 1970s into one song, this would be it. See […]
